mapper.select: select diagnosis_category, priority, eligible_queue_ref, required_facts, policy_version, active from ai_service_case_routing_rule where diagnosis_category = #{category} and active = 1 and policy_version = 'v1' limit 1
mapper.insert: insert ignore into ai_service_case ( case_id, member_id, case_key, queue_ref, diagnosis_category, priority, state, state_version, assignee_ref, public_status, customer_information_type, customer_information, last_public_message, created_at, updated_at ) values ( #{caseId}, #{memberId}, #{caseKey}, #{queueRef}, #{diagnosisCategory}, #{priority}, #{state}, #{stateVersion}, #{assigneeRef}, #{publicStatus}, #{customerInformationType}, #{customerInformation}, #{lastPublicMessage}, now(), now() )
mapper.select: select * from ai_service_case where member_id = #{memberId} and case_key = #{caseKey} limit 1
select * from ai_service_case where case_id = #{caseId} and member_id = #{memberId} limit 1
select * from ai_service_case where member_id = #{memberId} order by updated_at desc, id desc limit 50
select action_type, result_code, public_message, created_at from ai_service_case_action where case_id = #{caseId} and public_message is not null order by id asc limit 50
mapper.update: update ai_service_case set state='CANCELLED', state_version=state_version+1, public_status=#{publicStatus}, last_public_message=#{publicMessage}, updated_at=now() where case_id=#{caseId} and member_id=#{memberId} and state_version=#{expectedVersion} and state in ('QUEUED','CLAIMED','AWAITING_CUSTOMER_INFORMATION','IN_REVIEW')

update ai_service_case set state='REOPENED', state_version=state_version+1, customer_information_type='problem_description', customer_information=#{reason}, public_status=#{publicStatus}, last_public_message=#{publicMessage}, updated_at=now() where case_id=#{caseId} and member_id=#{memberId} and state_version=#{expectedVersion} and state='RESOLVED' and updated_at >= date_sub(now(), interval 7 day)
mapper.insert: insert into ai_service_case_action ( action_id, case_id, actor_kind, actor_ref, action_type, expected_version, result_code, public_message, internal_note, idempotency_key, correlation_ref, created_at ) values ( #{actionId}, #{caseId}, #{actorKind}, #{actorRef}, #{actionType}, #{expectedVersion}, #{resultCode}, #{publicMessage}, null, #{idempotencyKey}, #{correlationRef}, now() )

insert into ai_service_case_outbox ( event_id, case_id, member_id, event_type, state_version, correlation_ref, status, attempt_count, available_at, lease_until, published_at, last_error, created_at, updated_at ) values ( #{eventId}, #{caseId}, #{memberId}, #{eventType}, #{stateVersion}, #{correlationRef}, 'PENDING', 0, null, null, null, null, now(), now() )
